extension.title: MarkVault Browser Extension
extension.subtitle: Save tab groups with one click for efficient bookmark management
extension.releaseInfo: View the latest version, release notes and checksums on GitHub
extension.tip: 💡 Only the Chrome/Chromium universal package is provided (works on Chromium-based browsers like Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera)

saveTabGroups.title: One-click Tab Group Saving
saveTabGroups.description: Save all open tabs to MarkVault with one click, including titles, URLs, and favicons

restoreTabs.title: Quick Tab Restoration
restoreTabs.description: Restore previously saved tab groups from MarkVault website to continue your work

autoSync.title: Auto Sync
autoSync.description: Tab groups automatically sync to cloud for seamless multi-device access

step1.title: Download Extension Package
step1.description: Click the download button above to get the markvault-extension-chrome.zip file

step2.title: Extract Files
step2.description: Extract the downloaded zip file to any folder (preferably a permanent location)

step4.title: Enable Developer Mode
step4.description: Toggle on 'Developer mode' in the top right corner of the extension management page

step5.title: Load Extension
step5.description: Click 'Load unpacked' and select the extracted folder

step6.title: Installation Complete
step6.description: The extension icon will appear in the browser toolbar, click to use

tips.title: 💡 Usage Tips
tips.tip1: First-time use requires configuring MarkVault website URL and API Key in the extension
tips.tip2: API Key can be created on the website's 'API Keys' page
tips.tip3: Pin the extension icon to toolbar for quick access
tips.tip4: Extension automatically saves tab titles, URLs, and favicons

faq.title: ❓ FAQ
faq.q1: Can't find the extension icon after installation?
faq.a1: Click the puzzle icon on the right side of the browser toolbar, find MarkVault extension and click the pin button to show it in the toolbar.
faq.q2: How to get an API Key?
faq.a2: After logging into MarkVault website, click 'API Keys' in the user menu at the top right, create a new API Key and copy it to the extension settings.
faq.a3: Only the Chrome/Chromium version is provided: works on Chromium-based browsers like Chrome, Edge, Brave and Opera. Firefox is not supported for the extension at the moment.
faq.q4: Can Chrome and Edge use the same version?
faq.a4: Yes! All Chromium-based browsers use the same Chrome/Chromium version.
faq.q5: Where to view saved tab groups?
faq.a5: View and manage all saved tab groups on the 'Tab Groups' page of MarkVault website.

commitment.description: MarkVault is committed to protecting user privacy and data security. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal information.

security.title: Data Security
security.description: We take multiple security measures to protect your personal information:
security.item1: HTTPS is configured by the instance administrator through a reverse proxy
security.item2: Passwords are stored as salted hashes; third-party AI API keys are encrypted with an instance key
security.item3: JWT tokens are used for authentication
security.item4: Bookmarks, snapshots, and images are stored on the instance disk without automatic disk encryption
security.item5: Administrators should back up data and update the runtime regularly

faq.title: FAQ
faq.a1: Click the 'Add Bookmark' button in the top right corner, fill in the bookmark information and save. You can also use the browser extension to quickly save the current page.
faq.a2: When creating or editing a bookmark, you can add tags to it. Click on tags in the sidebar to filter corresponding bookmarks.
faq.a3: Go to 'General Settings' → 'Share' tab, enable public sharing, and the system will generate a public link for others to access.
faq.q4: How to get an API Key?
faq.a4: Go to 'General Settings' → 'API' tab, click 'Create' button to generate a new API Key for browser extension or third-party apps.
faq.q5: How to install the browser extension?
faq.a5: Visit the 'Browser' page, download the extension file for your browser, and follow the instructions to install.
faq.a6: Go to 'General Settings' → 'Basic' tab, choose light, dark, or system theme.
faq.a7: Data is stored in the instance's SQLite and object-storage directories and protected with JWT authentication. Administrators should protect the keys and backups.
